# Pak Multilinks Hygiene

> Wholesale corporate hygiene and cleaning products supplier in Lahore, Pakistan. 125 products across 4 categories for businesses, offices, hotels, and institutions.

Pak Multilinks Hygiene (https://pakmultilinks.com) is a B2B wholesale supplier of corporate hygiene and cleaning products based at Shop No LG-9, Rehman Tower, Main Market Gulberg II, Lahore, Pakistan. Slogan: "Your Hygiene Partner".

## Key facts

- Business type: Wholesale corporate hygiene supplies (B2B only)
- Location: Shop No LG-9, Rehman Tower Main Market Gulberg II, Lahore, Pakistan
- Catalog: 125 products across 4 categories
- Brands stocked: Dettol, Harpic, Vim, Surf Excel, Ariel, Rose Petal, Hi-Jeen, Fay, Domex, Lysol, Mortein, Colin, Glade, Ambipur, Air Wick, Brite, Sufi, Robin, Rin, Lemon Max, Tyfon, Kingtox, Cobra, Finis, Express Power, Wheel, Butterfly, Selpak, Scotch-Brite, and more
- Minimum order: 1 carton per product
- Ordering: website cart, WhatsApp, or quotation form
